Earnings data are available annually over the years 1951 to 2001 and quarterly from 1962 to 2001.
Returns are obtained from the Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) data file.

review_notes: Source-first scope: the paper states that it evaluates the power and reliability of the differential-timeliness measure. Retain the pooled annual full-sample Regression (1) estimate as the principal measurement-family fit; the quarterly firm-time-series summary, simulated or event-condition estimates, portfolio/announcement partitions, and Section VII comparisons with other conservatism measures are follow-up sensitivity, validation, or application analyses rather than distinct principal outcomes.

The source and supplied coordinator-verified transcription establish the full Equation (1) RHS, interaction, and Price_(j,t-1) denominator. The annual pooled estimate is 0.302 on 131,920 firm-years. The specific annual Return window and underlying estimator are not identified for this fit, so status remains needs_review.
